columns.name: InvoiceNo
columns.description: Invoice identifier. String, not numeric: cancellations are prefixed with 'C', so parsing it as a number silently drops them.

columns.name: StockCode
columns.description: Product identifier. Alphanumeric ('85123A'), so it cannot be numeric.

columns.name: Description
columns.description: Free-text product name. Genuinely nullable in the source; the transform drops those rows.

columns.name: Quantity
columns.description: Units on the line. Negative on cancellations, which the transform removes.

columns.name: InvoiceDate
columns.description: Invoice timestamp. Declared datetime so a batch arriving as text fails here rather than at the first date_trunc downstream.

columns.name: CustomerID
columns.description: Customer identifier. Float rather than integer only because pandas represents a nullable integer column that way on read; roughly a quarter of rows have no customer, which is expected and must not fail the batch.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Destination country. Small controlled vocabulary; a cardinality jump means a picklist was replaced with free text upstream.
